news_codex_ratings.json.review_mode: Scheduled cloud dual-review; independent Codex desk
limitations: Confidence values are subjective evidence confidence, not return probabilities. News remains unweighted in the trading score.

Only material new or materially changed evidence is added. Valid current-session ratings from the prior Codex review are retained when no contrary evidence has appeared; an unreviewed story is not a Neutral rating.

The linked Mettis Global cement-sector article could not be opened in this cloud reader and its article-page clock could not be independently verified. It is therefore reviewed as headline-only sector evidence and is not made score-bearing.

The Engro succession story is now supported by a readable full article with an explicit 09:26 PKT publication time plus a same-day PSX-linked announcement reference, replacing the prior headline-only limitation. The evidence still does not establish a near-term earnings or cash-flow change.
Stories not reviewed are not Neutral ratings.

reviewed_stories.title: Vessels trickle through Strait of Hormuz as Mideast tension persists
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Sector evidence for tracked Oil & Gas Exploration companies OGDC, PPL and MARI because sustained Hormuz constraints support a geopolitical crude and hydrocarbon risk premium.
reviewed_stories.reason: Reuters reported only 12 commodity vessels transited Hormuz over the weekend versus 35 the prior weekend and visible traffic remains a trickle. This confirms continuing physical transit risk for a route that handled a major share of global oil and LNG before the war, which is supportive for upstream producers, although some untracked traffic continues.

reviewed_stories.title: Oil hits over 1-week low on hopes of boost to diplomacy in Iran war
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Sector evidence for tracked Oil & Gas Exploration companies because lower crude prices reduce the upside from the existing geopolitical risk premium.
reviewed_stories.reason: Reuters reported Brent at $101.71, down 2.08% and at its lowest since September 10, as hopes for diplomacy and a partial recovery in Saudi shipments removed part of the war risk premium. Saudi exports recovered above 4 million bpd in September and broader Middle East flows remained relatively resilient, which weakens but does not erase the upstream positive.

reviewed_stories.title: Engro Corporation Names Junaid Iqbal as Next President and CEO
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Direct governance linkage to Engro Corporation, a wholly owned subsidiary of tracked listed parent Engro Holdings Limited (ENGROH).
reviewed_stories.reason: The full article says Engro Corporation approved Junaid Iqbal as successor to Ahsan Zafar Syed, with Iqbal taking over after Syed's term ends in April 2027 and a structured transition in the meantime. This is verified company-specific governance news, but the announcement does not establish a near-term change in earnings, cash flow, ownership or capital allocation, so the assessment remains neutral.

reviewed_stories.title: Govt invites bids for first 400MW wheeling auction, says it is exiting power procurement
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Power-sector reform context for tracked generation and distribution names, without company-specific contract or earnings evidence.
reviewed_stories.reason: Pakistan opened the first 400MW CTBCM wheeling auction so large consumers can buy from chosen generators. The reform could alter competition and contracting over time, but the article does not identify a tracked company's award, tariff, volume or cash-flow impact. It remains neutral sector context.

reviewed_stories.title: Malik says govt ensuring uninterrupted fuel supply
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Oil-marketing sector context including PSO; no PSO-specific margin, reimbursement or earnings evidence.
reviewed_stories.reason: The petroleum minister said fuel supply is being maintained and relief-mechanism payments reached about 7,300 pumps. That is operationally constructive, but it does not establish settlement of the OMC industry's outstanding price-differential claims or implementation of the pending OMC margin increase. The fresh story is therefore neutral for PSO.

reviewed_stories.title: Pakistan's cement sector enters volume-led upcycle
reviewed_stories.linkage_detail: Headline-level sector evidence for tracked cement names including DGKC, FCCL, MLCF, DCL, KOHC and THCCL.
reviewed_stories.reason: The fresh headline characterizes Pakistan cement as entering a volume-led upcycle, which is directionally positive for sector demand. The linked Mettis article body could not be opened and its article-page clock could not be independently verified in this cloud session, so no dispatch, pricing, margin or company-specific detail is attributed to it and it is not made score-bearing.
reviewed_stories.published: 2026-09-21; exact article clock time unavailable in this cloud session

OGDC.reason: Hormuz traffic remains severely constrained, but Brent fell to $101.71 as diplomacy hopes and recovering Saudi shipments reduced the risk premium. The upstream effect remains positive.
OGDC.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration; OGDC directly sells produced hydrocarbons.

PPL.reason: Hormuz traffic remains severely constrained, but Brent fell to $101.71 as diplomacy hopes and recovering Saudi shipments reduced the risk premium. The upstream effect remains positive.
PPL.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration; PPL directly produces and sells hydrocarbons.

MARI.reason: Hormuz disruption remains supportive for upstream hydrocarbons, while Brent's fall to $101.71 and recovering Saudi flows reduce the supply-risk premium. MARI remains positive at lower confidence because crude is only part of its hydrocarbon exposure.
MARI.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration; MARI produces and sells hydrocarbons.

Oil Marketing.reason: Government says fuel supply is being maintained and relief payments reached about 7,300 pumps, but the fresh article does not establish settlement of OMC price-differential claims or implementation of the pending margin increase.
